patch.value: Outcome milestone: measured self-improvement — every shipped improvement closes an evidence-selected, gated, re-measured cycle

Graduate pm from a project that measures quality to a project whose own immutable evidence selects the next improvement and proves the resulting change moved a declared outcome metric. This milestone is an outcome gate over the existing recursive self-improvement programme rather than a new implementation programme.

Every shipped improvement cycle begins from a versioned evidence-ranked candidate rather than filing recency; Every cycle records baseline target gate decision landed change and post-change measurement as reconstructable immutable evidence; At least three consecutive production cycles improve their declared metric without weakening another blocking invariant; Candidate selection false-positive rate cycle lead time escaped-defect rate and tokens per completed cycle have published baselines and ratchets; A third party can replay any completed cycle through the public SDK and independently reproduce its verdict
Make recursive self-improvement a measured outcome rather than a narrated aspiration
The project continuously improves from its own evidence while preserving human review and immutable accountability
Turns history recurrence context economics and assurance into one closed improvement loop
A repeatable auditable self-improvement capability that demonstrates sustained measured gains
The recursive self-improvement epic and its delivery slices now exist but the portfolio has no outcome gate beyond universal-domain capability
